package.author: Bartels Media GmbH
package.description: Macro Recorder captures mouse events and keystrokes like a tape recorder, enabling automation of tedious procedures on your computer.

en-US.author: Bartels Media GmbH
en-US.description: Macro Recorder captures mouse events and keystrokes like a tape recorder, enabling automation of tedious procedures on your computer.
en-US.longDescription:
Macro Recorder can record your mouse and keyboard actions you are performing on your Windows or Mac computer.
You can then playback the recorded procedure as often as you want or save the recording into a file for later use.
It works as easy as a tape recorder: Record, Stop, Playback.
en-US.name: MacroRecorder
en-US.releaseNotes:
Major new version 5 with many new features.
This is a free upgrade if your license has valid maintenance. Renewals are available at discount.

zh-CN.description: Macro Recorder 能像录音机一样捕捉鼠标事件和按键操作，从而在电脑上自动化操作繁琐的程序。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Macro Recorder 可以记录你在 Windows 或 Mac 电脑上执行的鼠标和键盘操作。
然后，您就可以随心所欲地回放录制的程序，或将录制的程序保存到文件中，以供日后使用。
它的操作就像录音机一样简单：录音、停止、回放。
